note: Weekly target = September monthly GA4 target × 7/30. Hong Kong booked 987 GA4 bookings against an 899 blended weekly target, 9.8 percent ahead, down 1.4 percent week on week and up 18.1 percent year on year. Four of six venues beat the weekly target, led by The Chinese Library (+42.3 percent) and Shiro (+37.3 percent). Aqua HK (−3.2 percent) and Dim Sum Library (−23.4 percent) are the two below target, and the same two are the only venues behind on the FY-to-date line (−6.7 and −8.3 percent). Year to date the portfolio is 6.6 percent ahead of target. Vesu remains excluded from the portfolio view, but it booked 100 this week against 53 the week before and 58 in the same week last year — its first week clear of the 2025 line since reopening, and worth a look before it is read as settled.
